annotations.text:
Ic² / COSMIC Framework — Rubin prediction carousel.
Content from the registered test: prediction filed 31 July 2025, Zenodo doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16639922.
Built on the house system: Anton / IBM Plex, navy #070b18, cyan→green and gold→red gradients, HUD corners, notched panels.
Each card is 1080×1350 (4:5); substantive content sits between y=140 and y=1185 so the profile-grid crop stays clean.
Card 05 is the logo card — the reel animates the mark.
